basic_info.description: Timeless 1925 Spanish Mediterranean in San Francisco's sought-after Richmond District, near Sea Cliff, Lincoln Park and Lands End. This classic three-level home showcases signature architectural details including arched windows, wrought iron accents, a red-tile roofline, and a striking bay window that fills the interior with natural light. Inside, you'll find high ceilings, 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, plus a dedicated office, along with gracious formal living and dining rooms and a period kitchen with a charming breakfast nook. A private bonus retreat with closet and full bath, accessible through the garage and overlooking the backyard, ideal as guest quarters, home office, or studio. Set on a lovely block between California and Clement, with Andronico's and CVS across the street, you'll enjoy easy access to Golden Gate Park, Clement Street dining, Balboa cafes, and all neighborhood conveniences. With period details throughout and a huge backyard, this residence combines timeless character, versatility, and a prime location in one of the city's most desirable pockets.
